_note: The classProfessions and tipsMatrix blocks every 20-40 pack used to repeat. Kept once here for reference. The build does not read this file: research/professions/class_professions.json and tips_matrix.json already cover all nine classes, and pack blocks were only used for classes missing there.

primary.reason: (dps) Leveling: Mining feeds Blacksmithing, which makes weapon and plate upgrades as you level; the Lodestone and Sharpening Wheel camp objects add melee power.

(dps) Level 60: Weapons carry warrior damage, so a smith arms both hands while leveling; at 60 Engineering adds bombs and gadgets. Fury should keep First Aid high because Victory Rush is its only self-heal.
(tank) Level 60: A tank wants shields, shield spikes and armor elixirs; Blacksmithing plus Alchemy covers both, and First Aid potions and cures are now First Aid-only in Forever.

secondary.reason: Forever moved healing potions to First Aid and added poultices and tourniquets; rated S or A for most specs. Level it with your cloth.
Food gives small XP and stat buffs in Forever and cooks build campfires for camp buffs; pair with Fishing.
Feeds Cooking; Fish Bowl camp object. Lowest value of the three for most specs, but it costs no primary slot.

levelingPlan.note: Copper in any starting zone (Poor Copper veins were cut in starter areas).
Tin/Silver in the Barrens, Ashenvale, Thousand Needles. Journeyman at 50 (level 10), Expert at 125 (level 20).
Iron/Gold in Arathi, Desolace, Stranglethorn, Thousand Needles.
Mithril/Truesilver in Tanaris, the Hinterlands, Azshara. Artisan at 200 (level 35).
Thorium in Un'Goro, Burning Steppes, Winterspring, Eastern Plaguelands.

Reach 75 and train the next rank (Journeyman needs 50 skill + level 10, Expert 125 + level 20, Artisan 200 + level 35). Feeds on Mining bars; Forever smiths also need Sulfuric Acid and Sandpaper from other professions.

primary.reason: (dps) Leveling: Mining feeds Blacksmithing, which makes weapon and plate upgrades as you level; the Lodestone and Sharpening Wheel camp objects add melee power.
(dps) Level 60: Undead Paladin is a new Horde option in Forever. A smith supplies two-handers while leveling and the smith-only Legionite Glaive at 60; Engineering adds ranged tools.

(tank) Level 60: Shields, spikes and tank plate from Blacksmithing plus Alchemy elixirs. / (healer) Level 60: Mana elixirs and flasks first; Blacksmithing healing plate is BoE so it can also be bought.

secondary.reason: Forever moved healing potions to First Aid and added poultices and tourniquets; rated S or A for most specs. Level it with your cloth.
Food gives small XP and stat buffs in Forever and cooks build campfires for camp buffs; pair with Fishing.
Feeds Cooking; Fish Bowl camp object. Lowest value of the three for most specs, but it costs no primary slot.

Mithril/Truesilver in Tanaris, the Hinterlands, Azshara. Artisan at 200 (level 35).
Thorium in Un'Goro, Burning Steppes, Winterspring, Eastern Plaguelands.
